$comment: Points editor/agent language servers at the SAME interpreter pyrefly and pytest use.
Without this, a language server started outside `uv run` resolves imports against the
system Python, which has no reflex/duckdb/playwright installed, and reports
'Import "reflex" could not be resolved' on italy_dashboard/theme.py and every other
framework import in the repo -- pure false positives: `.venv/bin/pyrefly check` reports
0 errors on the same files. Type checking in CI is pyrefly (see [tool.pyrefly] in
pyproject.toml); this file exists only so an editor agrees with it.
